key.name: servers
key.description: JSON array of Zabbix server definitions (id, label, baseUrl, apiPath, authMode, username, hostFilter, color, enabled). API tokens are never stored here — they live in the login keyring (see src/shared/secrets.js).

key.name: active-server-id
key.description: Id of the server whose card is expanded in the dropdown. An empty value, or an id that no longer exists, falls back to the first enabled server.

key.name: credentials-revision
key.description: Incremented by the preferences window whenever a stored credential changes, so the running extension rereads it without a restart. Internal bookkeeping; there is no user-facing control.

key.name: open-on-hover
key.description: Open the dashboard when the pointer rests on the panel icon. Turn this off to require a click.

key.name: hover-open-delay-ms
key.description: How long the pointer must rest on the panel icon before the dropdown opens. Lower values feel snappier but open the menu on an accidental pass-over.

key.name: hover-close-delay-ms
key.description: Grace period before the dropdown closes after the pointer leaves the icon or the menu. Keeps the menu open while the pointer crosses the gap between them.

key.name: pin-on-open
key.description: When enabled the dropdown ignores the hover close timer and stays open until you click elsewhere or press Escape. Useful while reading long host lists.

key.name: poll-interval-seconds
key.description: How often live values are fetched while the panel is idle. The dropdown refreshes immediately on open regardless of this setting. Values below 10 seconds are clamped to 10 to protect the Zabbix server.

key.name: history-window-minutes
key.description: Width of the trend history shown behind each metric. 60 minutes gives a one-hour sparkline; 1440 covers a full day.

key.name: timeout-seconds
key.description: Per-request timeout for Zabbix API calls. Raise it for servers behind a slow VPN or tunnel.

key.name: max-hosts-per-server
key.description: Upper bound on the number of hosts fetched per server. Prevents a large Zabbix installation from making the dropdown unbounded.

key.name: insecure-tls
key.description: Accept self-signed or otherwise untrusted TLS certificates for every server. Prefer fixing the certificate chain; only enable this on a private network you control.

key.name: metrics-enabled
key.description: Which utilization tiles are shown for each host. Valid ids: cpu, memory, swap, disk, network, containers, load, uptime, processes. Unknown ids are ignored.

key.name: warn-threshold
key.description: Percentage utilization at which a metric turns amber.

key.name: critical-threshold
key.description: Percentage utilization at which a metric turns red. Values at or below the warning threshold are ignored, so the critical colour is always reachable.

key.name: show-panel-value
key.description: Display the selected metric's number next to the panel gauge. The ring shows the level either way; the number makes it exact.

key.name: panel-metric
key.description: Metric summarized by the panel gauge: cpu, memory, disk, or problems. The value is taken from the active server's first host; problems closes the ring and colours it by the worst open problem.

key.name: panel-alert-on-problems
key.description: Notch a dot into the panel gauge's rim, in the colour of the worst problem, when the active server reports unacknowledged problems. The metric's own colour is left alone.

key.name: density
key.description: Tile layout: compact, comfortable, or spacious. Compact fits more hosts without scrolling.

key.name: accent-colour
key.description: Dashboard accent palette: aurora, ocean, ember, or graphite. Applies to highlights and sparkline fills; severity colours stay green/amber/red.

key.name: reduce-motion
key.description: Disable sparkline and hover animations. Enabled automatically when GNOME's own animations are turned off.

key.name: notify-on-critical
key.description: Send a desktop notification when a host crosses the critical threshold while the dropdown is closed.

key.name: notify-on-new-problems
key.description: Send a desktop notification when a server reports a problem that was not present on the previous poll.

key.name: notification-cooldown-minutes
key.description: Minimum time between repeated notifications for the same metric so a sustained alert does not spam the desktop.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Log every Zabbix request to the journal. Never logs the API token; turn off after troubleshooting.
